title: UK Biobank
description: Array of UK Biobank participant records. One element is one participant, keyed by eid. Questions UK Biobank asks at several assessment visits carry only the initial-visit (instance 0) value; the repeat and imaging visits are out of scope. Any column except eid may be null, which is how an empty cell in the delivered data is written (D048).
$comment: Categories are wired into this allOf one at a time as each is converted (CONVERT.md). See PROGRESS.md for the category plan. After the categories come the 87 routing conditionals R-ids in ROUTING.csv (D049).
